newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to adjust sugar storage rules.
newsitem.headline: EU to adjust sugar storage rules.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee is due to discuss a technical amendment to its minimum storage rules on Wednesday, a member state official said.
"The Commission will present a proposal for a minor technical change to ensure the arrangement conforms with the GATT," the official said on Tuesday.
EU sugar manufacturers are required to keep part of their "A" quota production in store for use in times of emergency.
Currently the required amount is set at zero but the usual rate is between zero and three percent, the official added.

"The committee is otherwise due to hold a routine meeting to deal with the usual weekly tenders, two weekly periodic export refunds and molasses import duties," the official said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
